title: A Letter
author: a hermit
pages: You looked straight through her. She stood at my shoulder the whole time you were up here, and she liked you.
Do not take it hard. Your ki went to the cold, or the smoke, or the weight of things, whichever found you first. It does not go looking for anything else.
You will never see what I see. You will grow something of your own instead, harder than any of it. Watch for it when you are frightened, and do not run.
